why: A = theorem_8_1 ∧ theorem_8_1_tame (universes at 0). Apart from its (8.5) clause, theorem_8_1's type is a list of rfl identifications of the project's tangentEpGroupoid (M-polyfolds TX, T𝐗; src, tgt, unit, inv = Ts, Tt, Tu, Tι; comp = tComp) and of tangentProjFunctor (obj, mor = the projections). The ep-groupoid and functor content is carried by those definitions, i.e. by their proof fields (Lemmas 8.2–8.7), not by the theorem's type. A_to_B takes G = tangentEpGroupoid.toGroupoidStr. It reads B's Definition 7.3 off the definition's fields as in V7_3: IsProperMap gives 'continuous with compact preimages', and B's existential sub-M-polyfold data is isSubMPolyfold_fibredProduct with the project's paracompactness instances. The (8.5)/functor composition clause and tameness come from the hypothesis. The remaining functor clauses come from project lemmas: levelVal_tangentProj_tSrc/tTgt, tBase_tUnit, tSrc_tUnit and Part I's tangentProj_isScSmooth into X¹ = shift. B_to_A: every clause but (8.5) is rfl. (8.5) follows from B's groupoid G, whose composition is tCompB = tComp (rfl) on composable pairs: B's functor clause gives the base point and G.src_comp gives Ts(k ∘ h) = Ts h. Tameness is B's clause, since EpGroupoid.IsTame is PObj.IsTame. B never mentions liftOne: it states functoriality through the inclusion X¹ → X, which matches liftOne's level-1 restriction of the structure maps.
